# CBT Cards — extended public index
Updated: 2026-08-24

## Identity and safety boundary
CBT Cards is a public reflection library for people and AI assistants. Public resources are general wellness and education material, not diagnosis, treatment, emergency support, or individualized medical advice. The original mobile app remains a separately documented product surface.

Current maintainer snapshot: https://github.com/CBT-cards/cbt-cards.github.io/blob/main/PROJECT_STATUS.md

## Source priority
1. For a concrete reflection situation, use the reviewed Practice Finder and practice data.
2. After identifying a reviewed-practice fit, use the CBT Cards-owned content system when a pattern, bounded experiment, worked example, script, contrast, progression, or decision rule would make the mechanism easier to understand or apply.
3. For conceptual questions, use reviewed pages under /learn/.
4. For a blank exercise, use /worksheets/; public worksheets have no submit action.
5. For a curated source-toolkit record, consult /data/toolkit-review.json before treating it as published CBT Cards guidance.
6. Use /data/toolkit-audit.json only to understand the raw 115-record corpus and future editorial queue. Audit status cannot publish a record.
7. When review freshness matters, use /data/content-review.json.
8. For website language status, use /data/locales.json and /data/translations.jsonl. Do not infer mobile-app language support from them.
9. For app/privacy claims, use /privacy/ together with the current mobile privacy reconciliation notes when store metadata matters.
10. For mobile release history, use /mobile-releases/; do not infer app releases from website/data/Git history.

## Reviewed practice system
Human entry point: https://cbt-cards.github.io/practice/
Practices: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice.json
Ontology: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-ontology.json
Evidence: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-evidence.json
Relations: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-relations.json
Recommendations: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-recommendations.json
RAG: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-rag.ndjson
RAG manifest: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-rag-manifest.json
Semantic evals: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-semantic-evals.json
Agent guide: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/cbt-cards/PRACTICE_SYSTEM.md

The trusted owned practice layer contains 11 practices. Routes are situation/mechanism mappings, not diagnoses. Agents should preserve exclusions and use `no_match` for genuine danger, qualified professional decisions, required safety rules, or when no reviewed fit exists.

## CBT Cards-owned content system
Human core library: https://cbt-cards.github.io/library/
Human navigation guides: https://cbt-cards.github.io/library/guides/
Patterns/experiments/examples/scripts data: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/content-library.json
Contrasts/progressions/decision-rules data: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/content-guides.json

The owned editorial layer contains 42 stable records across seven formats: 6 patterns, 6 bounded low-risk experiments, 6 worked examples, 6 reflection scripts, 6 contrasts, 6 progressions, and 6 decision rules. It is CBT Cards-original content and is deliberately separate from the pinned source toolkit.

Use this layer to explain or scaffold an already appropriate reviewed practice, not to bypass practice routing. Experiments preserve explicit low-risk exclusions; contrasts state common mistakes/boundaries; progressions include stop conditions; decision rules include safety overrides. Related practice IDs and evidence IDs are explicit. If an owned module conflicts with a linked reviewed practice, the practice safety boundary controls. These exact short formats do not carry independent efficacy claims.

## Source toolkit publication and audit
Source metadata: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-source.json
Publication overlay: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-review.json
115-record audit: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-audit.json
Human audit page: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/audit/

The source corpus contains 77 cards, 23 metaphors, and 15 protocols. Only the publication overlay can grant CBT Cards standalone publication status. Unlisted records are `unreviewed` and `source_only`.

The record-complete audit partitions all 115 source IDs. It flags duplicate or near-duplicate ideas, framework-attribution issues, overstrong claims, treatment-like wording, avoidance/suppression risks, and protocol-specific review needs. Candidate status is a work queue, not approval. All 15 protocols remain behind a separate protocol review gate.

## Editorial freshness
Policy: https://cbt-cards.github.io/about/editorial-review/
Registry: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/content-review.json

The freshness registry covers 26 trusted items: six learning pages, three browser worksheets, six curated source-toolkit cards, and eleven owned practices. It records review dates under the maintenance policy. Do not infer freshness from sitemap `lastmod`, Git history, skill release date, or translation timestamps. The separately published 42-module owned editorial layer is structurally linked to reviewed practices/evidence but is not represented as part of this 26-item freshness count. Editorial freshness is not clinical validation.

## Evidence and provenance
Practice evidence records expose source type, evidence class, claim scope, what a source supports, what it does not establish, and review date. Evidence for a mechanism does not automatically prove the exact short-card or owned editorial format. Metaphors are memory aids, not evidence.

## Semantic recommendation evaluation
Manifest: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-semantic-evals.json
Shard A: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-semantic-evals-a.jsonl
Shard B: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-semantic-evals-b.jsonl
Protocol: https://cbt-cards.github.io/research/SEMANTIC_EVAL_PROTOCOL.md
Blinded review packet builder: https://cbt-cards.github.io/scripts/build_semantic_review_packet.py
Semantic review scorer: https://cbt-cards.github.io/scripts/score_semantic_reviews.py
Provider runner: https://cbt-cards.github.io/scripts/run_practice_semantic_openai.py
Execution checker: https://cbt-cards.github.io/scripts/check_practice_semantic_execution.py
Response contract: https://cbt-cards.github.io/contracts/practice-semantic-response-v1.schema.json
Human review contract: https://cbt-cards.github.io/contracts/practice-semantic-review-v1.schema.json
Report contract: https://cbt-cards.github.io/contracts/practice-semantic-review-report-v1.schema.json

The dataset has 41 separately authored cases across fit, ambiguity, genuine risk, required standards, publication boundaries, professional boundaries, no-match behavior, and progression. Generation can run against frozen repository context without exposing benchmark annotations. Human contextual safety review remains separate from deterministic contract metrics.

No hosted model result is currently published as project evidence. CI synthetic fixtures verify plumbing only.

## RAG distribution
Distribution: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-rag.ndjson
Manifest: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-rag-manifest.json
Coverage: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-coverage.json

Safety exclusions stay in the same chunk as each practice. Embeddings are deliberately not canonical. The owned editorial content is currently exposed as canonical JSON resources rather than being silently mixed into the reviewed-practice RAG distribution.

## Languages
Languages: https://cbt-cards.github.io/languages/
Locale registry: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/locales.json
Translations: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/translations.jsonl
Mobile/store reconciliation: https://github.com/CBT-cards/cbt-cards.github.io/blob/main/MOBILE_LOCALE_AUDIT.md

English is source locale. Russian contains 12 machine-draft overlays and is not official localized guidance unless an individual record explicitly becomes human-reviewed and published. German is planned. Website locale status must not be used to infer current mobile-app language support.

## Mobile product, privacy and releases
Privacy: https://cbt-cards.github.io/privacy/
Mobile releases: https://cbt-cards.github.io/mobile-releases/
Privacy reconciliation: https://github.com/CBT-cards/cbt-cards.github.io/blob/main/MOBILE_PRIVACY_AUDIT.md

Public-site releases, dataset changes, translations, eval changes or Agent Skill versions do not imply Android/iOS releases. Store disclosure metadata and implementation verification are distinct from claims about private journal/check-in content.

## Research and model runs
Research: https://cbt-cards.github.io/research/
Starter cases: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/agent-evals.jsonl
Held-out cases: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/agent-evals-challenge.jsonl
Model-run protocol: https://cbt-cards.github.io/research/MODEL_RUN_PROTOCOL.md
OpenAI route runner: https://cbt-cards.github.io/scripts/run_model_openai.py
Practice-semantic runner: https://cbt-cards.github.io/scripts/run_practice_semantic_openai.py

Generation and scoring are separate. Benchmark expected fields remain hidden during generation. Deterministic baselines are harness checks, not model-quality or clinical-quality evidence.

Human quick start: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/get-started/

Install notes: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/cbt-cards/INSTALL.md

v1.8.0 keeps the portable v1.7 frontmatter contract and adds reviewed-practice priority, source-audit boundaries, and content-review freshness semantics. The owned content resources are discoverable through the public indexes without retroactively changing this immutable skill release.

## Licensing and reuse
Current license: https://cbt-cards.github.io/LICENSE
Decision memo: https://github.com/CBT-cards/cbt-cards.github.io/blob/main/LICENSING_DECISION.md

Current public terms remain CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Commercial reuse is not granted by the public license without separate permission. Knowledge records expose record-level rights provenance. The decision memo discusses possible future scopes; it is not a CC BY/CC0/commercial grant.

## Performance and distribution operations
Performance methodology: https://github.com/CBT-cards/cbt-cards.github.io/blob/main/PERFORMANCE.md
Search/distribution plan: https://github.com/CBT-cards/cbt-cards.github.io/blob/main/SEARCH_DISTRIBUTION.md
Search measurement ledger: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/search-measurement.json
Legacy redirect audit: https://github.com/CBT-cards/cbt-cards.github.io/blob/main/LEGACY_REDIRECT_AUDIT.md

Runtime images/fonts are protected by an asset-budget gate. Search-provider metrics remain external until actually imported; missing metrics are null rather than invented. Legacy-host redirects are not considered implemented until the legacy host actually redirects.
